properties.name: Song of Kumarbi — Divine Succession
properties.summary: Alalu was overthrown by Anu (heaven), who was overthrown by Kumarbi, who bit off and swallowed Anu's genitals. From this act, the storm god Teshub was born and eventually defeated Kumarbi. This divine succession myth closely parallels the Greek Theogony's account of Kronos and Zeus.

properties.name: The Dragon Illuyanka
properties.summary: The Storm God was defeated by the dragon Illuyanka, who stole his heart and eyes. The goddess Inaras seduced Illuyanka with a feast, getting him drunk so a mortal could bind him. In another version, the Storm God's son married Illuyanka's daughter and recovered the organs, allowing his father to triumph.
